Trup se předklání, nohy jsou téměř napnu: Torso hinges forward, legs nearly straight, weight stays in the hips
Tělo je paralelně se zemí, osu přitahuje: Body parallel to the floor, pull the bar to your chest. Set the bar down on the floor between reps
U každého opakování podržíte 10-15 s v k: Hold each rep for 10-15 s in the contracted position
U země kolem GHD umístěte elastický band: Loop a resistance band around the base of the GHD and place it behind your neck. Use a thin band and have a spotter. For Russian curls you can hold a dumbbell
Umístěte elastický band o vysokém odporu: Attach a heavy band (thick green) from the top plate peg to the bottom handle so resistance rises through the range. Wide stance hits hamstrings and glutes more in the bottom, activating them before the deadlift
Umístěte lavici do silové klece a nachys: Bench in the rack, safeties set at shoulder height with shoulders pulled back. Start every rep from a dead stop on the pins. A bench with a shorter back pad helps keep the shoulder blades back and together
Umístěte před sebe step-box (jako na ste: Place a step box in front of you, put the toes of your front foot on it and lunge forward. Targets the rectus femoris and improves ankle and hip mobility
V leže na zemi se chytnou kladky protism: Lie on the floor between the cable crossover, grab the cables crossed over and do elbow extensions. Standard crossover cables may be too far apart; bands work as a substitute
V negativní fázi se předkloňte a zvyšte: Lean forward on the negative to increase the load, then lean slightly back on the positive
V polovině rozsahu prvního opakování pod: On the first rep, hold at the halfway point for 20 seconds, then do 8 reps as fast as possible
V silové kleci umístěte podélné zarážky: Set the safeties in the rack at about hip height, or as low as you can still stand up from in a front squat
Ve výši brady, napnuté paže (tlačím od s: At chin height with arms straight (pushing away), pull the shoulder blades together – retraction
At chin height with arms straight (pushing away), pull the shoulder blades together – retraction
Vzpažování na břiše – obkročmo na naklon: Prone overhead raise, straddling an incline bench. Pull the shoulder blades down as you raise the arms
Výpady provádíte s jednoručkou drženou n: Do the lunges holding a dumbbell at your chest
Všechny série provedete ihned po sobě be: Do all sets back to back with no rest, just alternating arms
Vůbec se toho nebojte a použijte externí: Don't hesitate to add weight on a belt, even if it's only 2.5 kg. Pull up until your shoulders touch the bar
Always lower until the upper arms rest fully on the floor
Always rest the entire upper arm on the floor
Zaměřit se na vrchní trapézy. Ramena sta: Focus on the upper traps. Pull the shoulders up and back
Zarážky jsou ve stejné výšce jako při B,: Safeties at the same height as in B, but now do a back squat
Zarážky si umístěte do výše pasu. Osa je: Set the safeties at waist height. Hold the bar in the crook of your elbows; use a foam pad or something soft under it
Zatímco při klasickém provedení Pendulum: Unlike the standard pendulum squat with an ATG stance, place your feet parallel to each other and do classic bodybuilding squats to parallel
Zjistěte Vaše pohodlné maximum pro jedno: Find your comfortable 1RM on the bench press
Zvolte variantu dřepu, která je Vám blíz: Choose the squat variation you prefer, ideally ATG (only as low as you can go without butt wink). Keep adding weight from the last set of front squats
Zády, úkrok do strany, paže jde před těl: Facing away, step out to the side, arm moves across in front of the body
Úchop na délku palce, po dotek s hrudník: Thumb-length grip (thumbs a thumb's length from the smooth center of the bar), lower until it touches your chest
Čelem, předklon jako u RDL, paže jdě do: Facing the cable, hinge forward like an RDL, arm moves out to the side. D1-D3: do all reps on one arm, then the other
Čelo si opřete o lavici se středním sklo: Rest your forehead on a medium-incline bench and do bent-over dumbbell rear delt raises
Špičky jsou přitažené k holením a směřuj: Toes pulled up toward the shins and pointed out
Špičky směřují k sobě a jsou přitažené k: Toes pointed in and pulled up toward the shins
Špičky směřují k sobě a jsou přitažené s: Toes pointed in and pulled up toward the shins
